companies.name: PSA(カード鑑定会社)
companies.sub: トレーディングカードの鑑定

relations.text: トレーディングカードのワンクリック鑑定と再販売でPSAと提携している
relations.text_en: eBay partners with PSA for one-click card grading and resale

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: one-click card grading and resale for trading cards through our partnership with PSA

relations.text: 分離・分配契約などでPayPalとの関係を定めている
relations.text_en: eBay has a separation and distribution agreement and other agreements with PayPal

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We entered into a separation and distribution agreement and various other agreements with PayPal to govern the Distribution and the relationship of the two companies.

relations.text: Adyenと商業契約を結び、同社株の取得権(ワラント)を得ていた
relations.text_en: eBay had a commercial agreement and a warrant to acquire Adyen shares

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We also entered into a warrant agreement in addition to a commercial agreement with Adyen N.V. (“Adyen”)

relations.text: 購入者向け決済手段としてKlarnaの導入を広げた
relations.text_en: eBay expanded the Klarna buyer payment option

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: the expansion of the Klarna buyer payment option

relations.text: Depopを買収する最終契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: eBay entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Depop

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In February 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Depop, Inc., a leading C2C fashion marketplace focused on recommerce

relations.text: 集客の多くをGoogle検索に頼っている
relations.text_en: eBay relies on Google search to direct a significant amount of traffic

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In addition, we rely on Google search to direct a significant amount of traffic to our platforms.

relations.text: 売り手の代替手段として、AmazonやAlibabaなどの総合ECがある
relations.text_en: Sellers can turn to general ecommerce marketplaces such as Amazon and Alibaba

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: including general ecommerce marketplaces, such as Amazon and Alibaba, and more specialized marketplaces that focus on discrete categories of products

companies.name: メタ・プラットフォームズ

relations.text: Facebook Marketplaceでも商品の売買ができる
relations.text_en: Consumers can buy and sell goods on Facebook Marketplace

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: consumers can buy and sell goods using social media, online aggregation and classifieds 14 Table of Contents platforms, such as Facebook Marketplace

relations.text: 売り手はShopifyなどのマルチチャネルサービスでも販売できる
relations.text_en: Sellers may sell through multi-channel services like Shopify

source.label: eBay 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Sellers may also choose to sell their goods through alternative channels, such as multi-channel services like Shopify or social media platforms.
